name: Riri
source: The [url=/c20901]Ravenscroft[/url] household's curious and mischievous maid. A competent and friendly maid, she is a bit worried about [url=/c20901]Christina's[/url] gullible and super honest personality. Lately, she has been interested in hearing about anything that happened to Chris at school, which she uses as a past time to enjoy herself.
